2.1.done: Nine raw tables read with declared types; sha256 of every file and of the IBGE archive, derived geometry and manifest in data_hashes.json (12 files).
2.1.label: observation

2.2.done: Declared types per the Milestone 2 cleaning schema; ZIP prefixes read as strings; categorical domains checked (violations kept, listed in audit.json); geolocation exact duplicates dropped: 261,831 of 1,000,163 rows. No imputation.
2.2.label: observation

2.3.done: ZIP/state median centroids after the IBGE boundary filter: 738,303 of 738,332 geolocation rows accepted; 19,023 keys, by status {'resolved': 19015, 'median_outside_polygon': 4, 'no_surviving_coordinates': 4}.
2.3.conclusion: Archive and derived geometry match the pinned hashes.
2.3.label: observation

2.4.done: Items, payments and reviews aggregated to order_id first, then left-joined one-to-one (pandas validate); output rows 99,441 = orders 99,441.
2.4.label: observation

2.5.done: The 24 predictors of e5lib/contract.py built with the Milestone 2 formulas; calendar fields numeric; has_items, freight_ratio_missing and payment_missing not built. Screening candidates (G-68, classification only, not predictors): product_photos_qty, product_description_lenght, product_name_lenght, est_delivery_days, customer_region, seller_region, region_pair, seller_prior_review_mean, seller_prior_review_count, seller_prior_detractor_share, seller_prior_delivered_count, seller_prior_late_share. Product fields from the primary item; est_delivery_days = estimated delivery date minus purchase; regions are the IBGE macro-regions of the customer and primary-seller states and their pair; seller history uses only the primary seller's events strictly before purchase, own order excluded.
2.5.label: observation

2.6.done: lead_days for delivered orders with delivery after purchase; is_detractor from the minimum valid score; first-review label kept. Min and first labels agree on 98,615 of 98,673 reviewed orders.
2.6.label: observation

2.7.done: Every raw and records column tagged known / not known at checkout (data_dictionary.csv, audit.json); date-order violations logged: {'order_purchase_timestamp <= order_approved_at': 0, 'order_approved_at <= order_delivered_carrier_date': 1359, 'order_delivered_carrier_date <= order_delivered_customer_date': 23, 'order_estimated_delivery_date > order_purchase_timestamp': 0, 'first review answer > order_purchase_timestamp': 63, 'order_delivered_customer_date > order_purchase_timestamp (delivered orders)': 0}.
2.7.reasoning: Zero-item orders are excluded from both tasks (ZERO_ITEMS, step 2.8): items can be removed after checkout, so a zero item count would leak a later cancellation. For the same reason has_items is not in the contract (G-30, G-61).
2.7.label: observation

2.8.done: Population rules applied per task and written to exclusions.csv; counts in exclusion_counts.csv. Test cutoffs (80/20 on eligible orders after the population rules, before the outlier rule): {'regression': '2018-05-27 12:30:34', 'classification': '2018-05-26 12:16:34'}.
2.8.reasoning: Lead-time outliers are applied to the regression population only, because lead_days exists only for delivered orders; distance outliers apply to both tasks. Flagged for the team to confirm.
2.8.label: observation

2.9.done: Lead-time threshold max(100, mean + 12 SD) = 133.71 days from pre-cutoff regression orders (mean 13.49, SD 10.02); distance limit 4397.53 km. Removals on or after each cutoff: [{'task': 'regression', 'outlier_removals_on_or_after_cutoff': 1}, {'task': 'classification', 'outlier_removals_on_or_after_cutoff': 0}].
2.9.label: observation

2.10.done: Orders with no usable payment_installments_max removed from both tasks (MISSING_INSTALLMENTS).

2.11.label: observation

2.12.done: data_dictionary.csv: 103 rows (every raw and records column, plus the three columns not in the contract); figures/data_structure.png with its link table.
